results.content: A ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM), a plataforma de IA GTM tudo-em-um, anunciou hoje um conector nativo entre o Microsoft Copilot Studio e o GTM.AI, a camada de contexto GTM headless da ZoomInfo. Os clientes em comum agora podem fundamentar cada agente construído no Copilot Studio, cada Copilot dentro do Dynamics 365 e o Copilot for Sales nos dados GTM verificados da ZoomInfo e na orquestração agêntica, sem middleware entre eles. O GTM.AI é a API e o Model Context Protocol (MCP) para agentes de IA, expondo o GTM Context Graph da ZoomInfo através da mesma interface que já alimenta o Salesforce Agentforce, HubSpot Breeze, IBM watsonx Orchestrate, Outreach AI, Claude e ChatGPT. Com o novo conector, cada superfície no stack do Microsoft Copilot herda a mesma base de dados verificados. [...] O que é o GTM.AI? O GTM.AI é a camada de contexto GTM headless da ZoomInfo. Ele expõe o grafo de dados verificados da ZoomInfo (100M de empresas, 500M de contatos e bilhões de sinais) juntamente com orquestração agêntica e governança no nível da plataforma através de API e Model Context Protocol (MCP). O GTM.AI alimenta dezenas de integrações concluídas, incluindo Salesforce Agentforce, HubSpot Breeze, IBM watsonx Orchestrate, Outreach AI, Gong, LeanData, Glean, Manus, Dust, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Google Workspace e agora o Microsoft Copilot Studio. But not everything needs to be acted on immediately. Some signals are better reviewed all at once, with context and prioritization across a rep’s book of business.

## From AI experimentation to AI execution

The GTM teams that win in the AI era won’t be the ones with the most pilots.

They’ll be the ones who can turn AI into a system for execution.

That requires: [...] That’s where most efforts break down today. And it’s what will define the next phase of AI in GTM — not building systems of intelligence, but systems of execution.

## AI needs more than a model. It needs a system of execution.

To move from experimentation to production, GTM teams need more than access to data.

They need a system that supports how AI actually operates in real environments — one that combines intelligence, control, and activation.

This includes:

 A continuously updated system of buyer intelligence
 Enterprise-grade permissioning and governance
 Orchestration across systems
 A managed way to connect that intelligence into the broader AI ecosystem [...] Just as importantly, it requires activation surfaces that bring insights directly into the workflows where revenue teams spend their time.

That is the role Common Room plays.

Common Room unifies buyer activity, identity, and GTM context across the full buyer journey — including product usage, website engagement, community activity, CRM data, and enrichment — into a continuously updated system of buyer intelligence.

On top of that foundation, we operationalize the intelligence so it can drive action inside real workflows.
